Want to join an energetic, international team where your hard work pays off big time? Whoop whoop! Besides a great starting salary of € 15.49 per hour, you can earn up to a massive € 28,66 per hour thanks to our awesome evening and weekend allowances! And the best part? - Up to € 28,66 per hour including  Sunday bonuses!
- A reliable base salary of € 15,49 per hour!

- Working in an international and fun team!
- Travel allowance of € 0,19 per km!

To keep the CB warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you match the following hard criteria:

- You speak and understand enough English or Dutch to have a conversation;

BAM! Say goodbye to boring routines. Your day as a warehouse worker is packed with variety, making time fly by. Together with your friendly colleagues, you will perform these key tasks:

- Collect book orders seamlessly using a smart, digital pick-to-light system 💡
- Restock the warehouse shelves efficiently so your team never runs out of items
- Pack orders neatly into boxes, slap on the shipping labels, and prepare them for transport 📦
- Keep your workspace tidy, organized, and safe

Where will you work
You will be stepping into the bustling fine distribution department

Do you want to get your workout in while getting paid? We’ve got you! As a Logistics Employer at PostNL, you are the reason people get their packages on time. No boring office desk for you; you’ll be active, moving, and making things happen.

You are a true go-getter who loves to stay active and keep moving. Hard work is part of your DNA, and lifting heavy packages is no problem for you—think of it as a free workout! - Transportation: You have your own way to get to Ledeboerstraat 76 (bike, scooter, or car).

Your day will be packed with variety—from sorting and processing to loading and unloading trucks. You’ll make sure every incoming parcel is placed in the correct roll container before they head onto the conveyor belt for final sorting. Once everything is in its right place, it’s ready for delivery—great job, superstar! If you feel like you're ready for the next level after a while, there are plenty of growth opportunities to explore. Who knows, you might be our next Team Leader! Your working hours will be as follows:

- Workdays: Monday to Saturday
- Working hours: 07:15 until 12
